invariants.rationale: The method returns a HoodieWriteMetadata object, so before returning it should not be null.
The result's internal list of WriteStatus should be initialized.
The size of the WriteStatus list should be zero or more.
The list of WriteStatus should not contain null elements.
The intention was to check something about elements but lambdas/streams are disallowed; thus no such invariant included.

meta.value: stream is not allowed at this program point
